-- Mewar-Sync Database Schema

-- 1. Profiles (Artisans and Visitors)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role TEXT CHECK (role IN ('SHOPKEEPER', 'VISITOR', 'ADMIN')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT,
  category TEXT,
  shop_address TEXT,
  preferred_language TEXT DEFAULT 'English',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 2. Ledger (Bahi-Khata)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ledger_entries (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  shop_id UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type TEXT CHECK (type IN ('SALE', 'BUSINESS_EXPENSE', 'PERSONAL_RECEIVED', 'PERSONAL_PAID', 'OTHER_EXPENSE')),
  category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('BUSINESS', 'PERSONAL')),
  item TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  unit_price NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  amount NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3. Inventory (Stock Management)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.inventory (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  shop_id UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  is_purchased BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  last_updated TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(shop_id, item)
);

-- 4. Products (Gallery)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.products (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  shop_id UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  style TEXT,
  image_url TEXT,
  is_verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Row Level Security (RLS)
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.ledger_entries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.inventory ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Policies: Profiles
CREATE POLICY "Users can view own profile" ON public.profiles FOR SELECT USING (auth.uid() = id);
CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile" ON public.profiles FOR UPDATE USING (auth.uid() = id);

-- Policies: Ledger (Artisan only)
CREATE POLICY "Artisans manage own ledger" ON public.ledger_entries FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = shop_id);

-- Policies: Inventory (Artisan only)
CREATE POLICY "Artisans manage own inventory" ON public.inventory FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = shop_id);

-- Policies: Products (Global View, Artisan Edit)
CREATE POLICY "Public can view products" ON public.products FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Artisans manage own products" ON public.products FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = shop_id);

-- Enable UUID extension for unique identifiers
CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

-- 1. Profiles Table (Linked to Supabase Auth)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.profiles (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE,
  role TEXT CHECK (role IN ('SHOPKEEPER', 'VISITOR', 'ADMIN')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  email TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  phone TEXT,
  category TEXT,
  shop_address TEXT,
  preferred_language TEXT DEFAULT 'English',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 2. Ledger Entries Table (Bahi-Khata)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.ledger_entries (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  shop_id UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  type TEXT CHECK (type IN ('SALE', 'BUSINESS_EXPENSE', 'PERSONAL_RECEIVED', 'PERSONAL_PAID', 'OTHER_EXPENSE')),
  category TEXT CHECK (category IN ('BUSINESS', 'PERSONAL')),
  item TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
  unit_price NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  amount NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- 3. Inventory Table (Stock)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.inventory (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  shop_id UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item TEXT NOT NULL,
  quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  unit_cost NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  is_purchased BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
  last_updated TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE(shop_id, item)
);

-- 4. Products Table (Gallery)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.products (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  shop_id UUID REFERENCES public.profiles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(15, 2) DEFAULT 0,
  style TEXT,
  image_url TEXT,
  is_verified BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Enable RLS (Row Level Security)
ALTER TABLE public.profiles ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.ledger_entries ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.inventory ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE public.products ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;

-- Create Policies
-- Profiles: Users manage their own
CREATE POLICY "Users manage own profile" ON public.profiles FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = id);
CREATE POLICY "Public profile view" ON public.profiles FOR SELECT USING (true);

-- Ledger: Artisans manage their own records
CREATE POLICY "Artisans manage own ledger" ON public.ledger_entries FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = shop_id);

-- Inventory: Artisans manage their own stock
CREATE POLICY "Artisans manage own inventory" ON public.inventory FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = shop_id);

-- Products: Everyone can view, but only owners can manage
CREATE POLICY "Anyone can view products" ON public.products FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Artisans manage own products" ON public.products FOR ALL USING (auth.uid() = shop_id);
